analysis.classification_rule: equivalent iff both intervals lie inside the margin; faster/slower iff both intervals exclude zero on the same side; otherwise unresolved

protocol.mode_proof: run once per cell before the timed window, from a proof session on the same server; failure aborts the run
protocol.outlier_policy: retain every successful cell; no post-hoc exclusions
protocol.schedule: one 7x7 Latin-square configuration order per workload per repetition (every configuration occupies every position at least twice over 16 repetitions); workload-block order shuffled

setup.dataset_initialization: baseline-a with module absent, followed by CHECKPOINT and confirmed normal shutdown
setup.pre_measurement: CREATE EXTENSION as required, CHECKPOINT, W4/W5 full account scan only, then fixed quiescence
setup.shutdown: pg_ctl fast, wait, required success before data removal

w3_qualification.scope: each active (stats/trace) W3 client population during warmup
